rbi_guidelines.title: RBI Circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18 — Zero Liability of Customer
rbi_guidelines.content: Clause 6 (Zero Liability of a Customer): A customer's entitlement to zero liability shall arise where the unauthorised transaction occurs due to contributory fraud/negligence/deficiency on the part of the bank, or third-party breach where the deficiency lies neither with the bank nor with the customer but elsewhere in the system, and the customer notifies the bank within 3 working days of receiving the communication.

rbi_guidelines.title: RBI Circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18 — Limited Liability & Social Engineering
rbi_guidelines.content: Clause 7 (Limited Liability of a Customer): In cases where the loss is due to negligence by a customer, such as where they have shared payment credentials or approved a deceptive UPI Collect Request, the customer will bear the loss until they report the unauthorised transaction to the bank. Any loss occurring after the reporting of the unauthorised transaction shall be borne by the bank. Immediate NPCI Lien Freeze on the beneficiary account must still be initiated to recover funds before cash-out.

rbi_guidelines.title: RBI Circular Clause 10 — Shadow Reversal / Provisional Credit within 10 Working Days
rbi_guidelines.content: Clause 10 (Reversal Timeline): The bank shall credit (shadow reversal) the amount involved in the unauthorised electronic transaction to the customer's account within 10 working days from the date of such notification by the customer, value-dated to the date of the unauthorised transaction.

rbi_guidelines.title: NPCI Unified Dispute & Issue Resolution (UDIR) & Real-Time Lien Marking
rbi_guidelines.content: NPCI UDIR Protocol: Remitter banks and PSP apps can invoke real-time API calls to place an immediate lien freeze on the fraudulent Payee VPA / beneficiary bank account using the 12-digit UTR number. Before issuing any automated refund, the remitter system MUST verify that the 12-digit UTR exists as SETTLED in the NPCI central switch ledger to prevent fake screenshot / fabricated receipt refund attacks.

rbi_guidelines.title: MHA I4C National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (1930) — Golden Hour Lien & Digital Arrest Advisory
rbi_guidelines.content: MHA I4C & RBI Joint Advisory on 'Digital Arrest' & Screen-Sharing Scams: Law enforcement agencies (CBI, ED, Police, Customs, RBI) NEVER conduct interrogations via video calls or demand money transfers to 'verification accounts'. Transactions flagged under active call or screen-sharing (AnyDesk/TeamViewer) must trigger immediate beneficiary lien freeze and automated 1930 CFCFRMS ticket generation.
